title: Server question answer validation
summary: Confirm that valid dialogs and battle choices resolve normally after the server validates each player's question answers. Malformed, unoffered and other-player replies are rejected by the real-server automated tests.
preparation: Use the Thor companion to verify and install this exact candidate. Prepare a disposable game with two meeting heroes, a Town visitor, a choice or yes/no map dialog, a hero approaching level-up, a neutral battle and a teleport with multiple exits if available.
limitations: Mark unavailable scenarios Blocked with notes. Ordinary device input cannot forge malformed or other-player packets; the real-server tests cover these. The activity runtime migration is still pending. CI and this checklist do not authorize merging.

checks.title: Hero Meeting and Town visitor exchange
checks.steps: Open a Hero Meeting, transfer and split units in both directions, close and reopen it. In a Town with a visitor, move units between garrison and visitor and close the window. If multiplayer is available, have the partner act while the initiator's exchange is open.
checks.expected: Only the initiator closes each exchange; both players' windows and current armies settle once. Legal transfers succeed, partner actions do not dismiss the wrong question, and no pending control remains.

checks.title: Choice and cancellation dialogs
checks.steps: Answer a map-object selection and a yes/no or cancelable question; repeat with the opposite valid choice or cancel in a disposable save. Open and dismiss a Town recruitment or utility window.
checks.expected: Each offered answer applies once to the intended object. Cancel leaves the corresponding action unapplied, and upper and lower contexts recover without a stuck dialog.

checks.title: Hero and commander level-up
checks.steps: Gain a hero level and choose an offered skill. If a commander level-up is available, answer it too. Continue moving or end the turn after the prompts; note any unavailable commander scenario.
checks.expected: Only the chosen offered skill is applied once. Prompts appear in order and close normally; the player is not stranded behind a pending question.

checks.title: Battle result and teleport answers
checks.steps: Finish a neutral battle and dismiss the result; where replay is offered, exercise it in a disposable save. Use a teleport with multiple destinations and try selection and cancel/random-exit behavior where available.
checks.expected: Dismiss and replay take their intended paths without double application. Teleport preserves its existing selection and cancel/random-exit behavior, and Adventure resumes with current controls.

checks.title: Display and input recovery
checks.steps: While a Meeting, choice dialog, level-up or battle result is open, toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume. Dismiss the current question with upper touch/controller, then check lower controls and single-display play.
checks.expected: The current question resolves once, one lower presentation returns without stale hit regions or held gestures, and upper touch/controller remain usable.
